sentence: This project develops methods to manage how electric vehicles, homes and offices use energy, including power flowing both ways, during power outages.
This project builds molecules that sense two targets at once and trigger a controlled response in mammalian cells only when both are bound.
This project studies the variety of single-celled microorganisms in geothermal springs and how they have adapted to survive in extreme environments.
This project tests whether corals with more immunity genes have less varied communities of microbes living inside them, using gene comparisons and laboratory experiments.
This project uses mathematics to study how stable currents form along the edges between different topological phases of matter and how fast they move.
This project studies how people use drawings to share ideas and whether drawings work more like pictures of objects or like words.
This project designs quantum computing methods that help microgrids using renewable energy switch smoothly between different controls and restore power.
This project tests whether artificial intelligence systems can use language as an interface to perception and reasoning, not as the foundation of intelligence.
This project studies how specialized veins in maize plants develop and which genes control them, using single cell genomics and machine learning.
This project studies how genes help cotton plants cope with drought and builds a computer model of how cotton grows with less water.
This project develops a plan to expand research computing resources on a campus and finds what specific computing needs its researchers have.
This project supports geographic and agricultural surveys, including restoring traditional plants to promote food security and monitoring ecology in remote communities.
This project develops theory and calculation methods to understand entanglement in many-body quantum systems, including when noise from realistic experiments is present.
This project uses glider data and machine learning to study frontal meanders and salty water intrusions on the warming continental shelf.
